## mid-raid defender d26 — talking to Sidney
[latelyKind=naming]
> YOU PICK [gq:open:take] 
YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "I think the asking matters more than the answer, out here. You know?"

> YOU PICK [dlg:help] 
YOU: "How can I help?"
NPC: "It's my spouse, Xiufang. Was taken at the Scattering. I tell everyone they were the interesting one. I need that to be true. Some nights I dream about the pods -- rows of them, humming. I wake up and I can't tell if it was a dream or a broadcast."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:naming] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "Have you heard what they're calling Sunback? Kenneth is pushing 'The Loud Thing'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."

> YOU PICK [gq:yn:yes] 
YOU: "Yes."
NPC: "Right. That's what I figured — which is why I asked you, not them."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About what was on their mind — we never finished."
NPC: "I just said — did you miss it?"

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:lately] 
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I'm staying out of the naming fight. For now. Someone always gets precious about their pick."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "What day is it? ...Do you still count? I lost track days ago."

> YOU PICK [ans:q_name_day:a_count] 
YOU: "I count. Someone has to."
NPC: "Good. Keep counting. The days need witnesses. — or so they tell me."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Go on."
NPC: "I should go. You know where to find me."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
(conversation ended by the engine)
